summary: Enhance your skills in accountability with our Partner-Funded Project Audits Training Course. Learn effective auditing techniques to ensure project success.
lede: Partner-funded project audits training helps professionals protect donor funds, oversee partners, and build clear evidence that spending follows agreements and project requirements. It develops an audit-smart approach to documentation, risk assessment, controls, and partner expenditure reviews before auditors arrive. You will learn to plan for audits, test transactions, review procurement and payroll, demonstrate value for money, and explain findings clearly. The course turns audits into a proactive accountability tool, helping you respond to issues constructively and support cleaner project delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with partner-funded or donor-funded projects and must deal with audits, compliance, and accountability.
modules: Foundations of Accountability and Project Audits
Understanding Donor and Partner Funding Arrangements
Internal Controls and Risk-Based Audit Thinking
Auditing Procurement and Asset Management in Projects
Audit Evidence, Documentation, and Working Papers
Audit Findings, Management Letters, and Corrective Actions
Partner Monitoring, Sub-grant Oversight, and Remote Audits
Communicating and Using Audit Results for Learning and Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of project management and financial reporting. Familiarity with donor-funded projects is beneficial, but not mandatory.
